summary: Iteration 17 (auth): tested backend auth (register/login/me/logout, bearer+cookie, 401 gates), recipe scoping (personal owner isolation) and admin-only Mikilab writes with pytest (21/22 pass), plus full UI e2e on the preview URL (auth gate, login admin+user, register, logout, session persistence, Home 4 concetti+foto, Ricette+Guida+Etichette senza prezzi, 6-tab nav, DE translation, 5 Maestro tools, personal recipe create+persistence, non-admin 403 on Mikilab edit, admin edit OK). Core auth and isolation work correctly. Main gaps: toasts invisible on the login screen, no admin gating in the recipe UI, no brute-force lockout, and every non-recipe endpoint is still unauthenticated/unscoped.

critical.issue: Only /api/recipes and /api/auth/me require a session. All other endpoints are open (no Depends(current_user)) and are NOT scoped by owner_id: any anonymous caller can read/modify lab config, production plans, weekly plans, oven profiles, announcements and burn the LLM key; all logged-in users also share the same plan/config documents instead of having private ones.
Unauthenticated endpoint that force re-syncs the whole Mikilab recipe collection (destructive/overwrites fields). Must be admin-only.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 7 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401, no 429/lockout (playbook requirement).

No unique index on users.email; DB already contains 2 duplicate records for michelecip918@gmail.com (auth_provider=google). Race on the Google callback creates duplicate accounts, so a user can end up bound to the 'wrong' user_id and lose their personal recipes. Add a unique index on users.email.
No password strength / email format validation (Pydantic str, not EmailStr); empty password returns 400 only via manual check.
Only deletes the session when the cookie is present; a Bearer-only client (headless) cannot revoke its token (Authorization header not read here).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True. Works today only because the frontend is same-origin; set explicit origins.
No single-recipe GET (405). Not blocking (UI uses the list), but noted for API consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: <Toaster/> is mounted only inside the authenticated App tree (App.js line 57), so toast.error/toast.success called from AuthScreen NEVER render. A wrong password gives zero visible feedback (verified: no message on screen, only a 401 in console). Mount Toaster above the auth gate or render an inline error element with data-testid.

No admin gating in the UI: normal users (fornaio@mikilab.de) see 'Aggiungi ricetta', 'edit-recipe-{id}' and 'delete-recipe-{id}' on Mikilab recipes. Saving fails with 403 and only a generic 'Errore nel salvataggio' toast while the dialog stays open (user loses the entered data and no explanation). RecipeList does not use useAuth; hide/disable these controls for role!=admin and surface err.response.data.detail.
On 390px width the brand subtitle is truncated to 'IL L...' next to the title (crowded header row with clock + lang + theme + logout).

issues: 5 controls compressed in the right cluster

action_items: Mount <Toaster/> outside the auth gate (or add an inline data-testid error) so login/registration errors are visible.
Gate recipe write controls in RecipeList by user.role (admin only for collection 'mikilab') and show the backend detail message on 403.

Add Depends(current_user) + owner_id scoping to oven-profiles, production-plan, weekly-plan, lab-config, recipe-temp, maestro chat/history, capo/plan, vision, scan-recipe, upload; make announcements writes admin-only.
Add unique index on users.email and de-duplicate the existing michelecip918@gmail.com records.
Add login rate limiting / lockout after 5 failed attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1245 lines: split auth, recipes and AI routers into modules.
AuthScreen relies on sonner toasts that are unreachable because the Toaster lives behind the auth gate.
current_user is only wired to recipes endpoints — the auth requirement is not enforced app-wide.
Verified good: bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$, session cookie is httpOnly/secure/samesite=none, sessions revoked on logout, mongo responses exclude _id.
seed_data_creation: Temporary users test_*@mikilab.test and TEST_ recipes were created and deleted afterwards; the admin note edited on 'Anima Integrale' was reverted.
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (admin), fornaio@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (user) — both valid, roles correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth verified working end-to-end: gate (auth-screen), email login for both accounts, register->auto-login, logout, session persistence across reload, IntroGuide shown after each login, personal recipe isolation (fornaio sees 0 others' recipes; created recipe persists), non-admin Mikilab write -> 403, admin write -> 200. Home shows the 4 concepts with photos for chi/metodo and no video/recipe list; Ricette has guida+labels buttons and labels contain no currency; DE switch translates recipe names (Süße Zwiebel). Not tested: real Google login (per instructions), slow AI endpoints. Re-test after fixes: Toaster on AuthScreen, role gating of recipe controls, auth on the remaining endpoints.
rca_of_the_issue: Login-error silence: sonner's <Toaster/> is rendered only in the authenticated branch of App.js, so AuthScreen's toast calls have no host. Non-admin edit UX: RecipeList never reads the auth context, so permission checks exist only server-side (403) and the UI shows a generic save error. Broad unauthenticated surface: current_user was added only to the recipes routes during this iteration.
